title: 第15章 强敌第16章 黑赤宫
slug: 玄幻我有机甲鬼才愿意去修仙
content_zh:
深入地下三四十米后，幽暗的洞内反而有了星星点点的光明。
漫天的发光小虫散发着五颜六色光芒，时而附在墙壁上，时而落在苔藓上，时而落在紫色的晶体上。
空气中弥漫着类似布丁奶茶的茶香味。
借着微弱的光，石泉水的目光便落在旁边的洞壁上，上面布满了人工开凿的痕迹。
这里应该是很早就开凿的，如果是金家很久以前准备的逃走密道，似乎也说的过去。
他挠了挠头，不清楚金家历史，对周阳镇历史也不甚了解。
所以无法推断这密道的建造时间。
看着幽深的密道，他有些担心前面的会不会是错综复杂的密道。但一路走下去，发现是多虑了。
一路上连一条岔路都没有。
不过，这洞里聚集了一些神奇的东西。
会飞的蓝色双头鼠、满身尖刺的蠕虫、黑色的竹子。
还有金色的矿石、红色的灵晶。
最多的应该是骸骨，以及他们生前持有的兵器。
石泉水捡起一把，用灵力测试了一下，只有微弱的灵力反应。
“据我所知，哪怕是废的武器，其残存的灵力也能保存上千年之久。”
“这剑伤没有缺损，也没有折断，灵力却只有这一丝丝，在这里怕已经超过了千年。”
石泉水觉得可惜，如果这些兵器灵力还充足，随便一把拿出去都能让普通人舒舒服服过个几辈子了。
“成家？”
靠近剑鄂处的剑身上还有铭文，不用想是打造者留下的。
他放下剑，去查看周围的兵器，除了偶然几把外，基本都有成家的铭文。

“这是玉？好像只有一半。”
在骸骨下，发现了一块长条形的玉制品，上面雕刻着鱼纹。
乍看起来，这鱼纹像是成字的一半。
“成家？完全没听说过。”
他在四下搜找后，收走了这半块玉。
继续往前走，骸骨越来越少，地上还散落着一些发黑的银子、首饰之类。
石泉水对这些没什么兴趣。
大约一刻钟后，走到了一个漆黑的地方，借着微弱的光，他依稀能判断这地方很大。
他打了个火诀，身前便有了一团篮球大小的火焰。
伸手一推，火焰分成五团小火焰，向四周扩散，大约照亮了两个篮球大小的空间。
一座诡异的雕像坟墓赫然出现在眼前。
雕像普遍不高，也就一米出头，密密麻麻的挤在一起，或站或倒，少说也有上千。
造型还各异，有的能看出是人，也有的像是猫，有的则是兽身人首。
雕像四周有四根直达洞顶的柱子，柱子上附着一团团黑色的东西。
“嗯？这些黑色东西怎么有灵力波动？”
一个黑影忽然动了一下。
石泉水马上意识到这些黑色东西是活物，不是每个人对未知生物都能鼓起勇气去一探究竟。
他后退了几步，紧盯着这些东西，生怕它们突然发动攻击。
“先生，你在里面吗？”
声音是霓羽的，声音方向却不是来路的方向。

“先生，你在哪里，我怎么看不见你。”
这次的声音是哲平的，方向是身前方向。
不对，这不是金小姐，也不是哲平。
他们就算跟来，也应该顺着我下去的路跟过来。
content_en:
After going thirty or forty meters underground, there were dots of light inside the dark cave.
The luminous bugs all over the sky emit colorful light, sometimes attached to the wall, sometimes falling on the moss, sometimes falling on the purple crystals.
The air is filled with the aroma of tea similar to pudding milk tea.
With the faint light, Shi Quanshui's gaze fell on the cave wall next to it, which was covered with traces of artificial excavation.
This place should have been dug a long time ago. If it was a secret escape route prepared by the Jin family a long time ago, it seems reasonable.
He scratched his head. He didn't know much about the history of the Jin family, nor the history of Zhouyang Town.
Therefore, it is impossible to infer the construction time of this secret passage.
Looking at the deep secret passage, he was a little worried that the one ahead would be a complicated secret passage. But along the way, I found that I was worrying too much.
There wasn't even a fork in the road.
However, there are some magical things gathered in this cave.
Flying blue two-headed rats, spiked worms, and black bamboos.
There are also golden ores and red spiritual crystals.
The most numerous ones should be the skeletons and the weapons they had during their lifetime.
Shi Quanshui picked up a handful and tested it with his spiritual power. There was only a weak spiritual power response.
"As far as I know, even if it is a useless weapon, its remaining spiritual power can be preserved for thousands of years."
"The sword is not damaged or broken, but it only has this sliver of spiritual power. It may have been here for more than a thousand years."
Shi Quanshui felt that it was a pity. If these weapons had enough spiritual power, just taking them out could make ordinary people live comfortably for several lifetimes.
"Getting married?"
There are also inscriptions on the sword near the jaw, so you don't have to think it was left by the maker.
He put down his sword and looked at the weapons around him. Except for a few of them, they all had the inscription of "Marriage" on them.
"Is this jade? It seems to be only half of it."
Under the bones, a long jade object was found with fish patterns carved on it.
At first glance, the fish pattern looks like half of the character.
"Starting a family? Never heard of it at all."
After searching around, he took away half of the jade.
As we continue to move forward, there are fewer and fewer bones, and some blackened silver, jewelry and the like are scattered on the ground.
Shiquanshui has no interest in these.
About a quarter of an hour later, he came to a dark place. With the faint light, he could vaguely judge that the place was very big.
He performed a fire technique, and a ball of flame the size of a basketball appeared in front of him.
With a push, the flame split into five small flames and spread around, illuminating a space about the size of two basketballs.
A strange statue tomb suddenly appeared in front of you.
The statues are generally not high, only a little over one meter, and they are densely packed together, either standing or falling. There are at least thousands of them.
The shapes are also different, some can be seen as humans, some look like cats, and some have animal bodies and human heads.
There are four pillars surrounding the statue that go straight to the top of the cave, with masses of black stuff attached to the pillars.
"Huh? Why do these black things have spiritual power fluctuations?"
A black shadow suddenly moved.
Shi Quanshui immediately realized that these black things were living creatures. Not everyone can muster up the courage to find out about unknown creatures.
He took a few steps back and stared at these things, fearing that they would suddenly attack.
"Sir, are you in there?"
The voice belonged to Ni Yu, but the direction of the voice was not the direction it came from.
"Sir, where are you? Why can't I see you?"
This time the voice belonged to Zheping, and the direction was in front of him.
No, this is not Miss Jin, nor Zheping.
Even if they come, they should follow the way I went down.
